title: •_Katana_
caption: _Dreadnaught_-Class Heavy Cruiser (V)
game_text: May add 3 pilots, 6 passengers, and 4 TIEs. Your other Dreadnaughts here are power +1, forfeit +2, Heroic, and immune to attrition < 4. Permanent pilot provides ability of 3. Immune to attrition < 4.
game_text_lines:
May add 3 pilots, 6 passengers, and 4 TIEs. Your
other Dreadnaughts here are power +1, forfeit +2,
Heroic, and immune to attrition < 4. Permanent
pilot provides ability of 3. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Introduced during the Clone Wars. 600 meters long. Some have cargo space converted to TIE hangar bays. Still used to maintain an Imperial presence in the Outer Rim.

notes: Group: Everything else. Unique (• added; printed card is non-unique). Caption '_Dreadnaught_-Class Heavy Cruiser (V)' (italic ship class), number 56. Heading '•_Katana_ (V)'. Frame proportions match the printed card (not a tall slip). Slip text matches the stub. CHANGES vs Decipher Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser (OTSD): title (and uniqueness); deploy 5 → 6; forfeit 5 → 6; power/armor/hyperspeed, destiny, lore, banner unchanged; game text replaced (printed: 'May add 3 pilots, 6 passengers and 4 TIEs. Your TIEs present are each power +1.'); icon column pilot ×2 + nav → permanent-pilot + nav. LORE CORRECTION: 'TIE hangar bays' (wiki 'hanger'; scan and slip print 'hangar').
